name: Stone wall with doorway
description: A section of village fieldstone wall, 1.5 m long, 0.45 m thick and 2.4 m high, with an empty door opening 1.0 m wide and 2.0 m high in the middle, framed by lighter dressed stone quoins on both jambs and a single heavy stone lintel, under a row of flat capstones. A wooden door (door_wood) is placed into the opening separately. The `_low` variant is a cutaway doorway: two quoined piers as high as the low walls, with no lintel.

provenance.prompt: A section of the same village fieldstone wall as wall_stone_straight (1 tile long along x through the tile centre, about 0.45 m thick, 2.4 m high) with a door opening: a clear passage 1.0 m wide and 2.0 m high in the middle, framed by dressed lighter stone quoins on both jambs and a single heavy stone lintel above. Footprint 1x1 tile. A wooden door (door_wood, 1.0 x 2.0 m) is placed into the opening separately, so leave the opening empty. Structure, static; blocks movement and sight (the opening itself is handled by the door), cover three-quarters, not destructible.
